method: AI-assisted inspection of full short normalized bodies or first 500 characters; rating-blind; same concrete-experience definition as preserved Steam review; not human-labelled ground truth
scope: Baseline mobile records plus separately identified recovered Apple page-2 records; pagination and repeat supplements excluded from semantic denominator
useful_definition: Visible content describes a concrete product experience, usability problem, preference with context, or experience-linked feeling. Generic praise, unsupported reactions and unrelated opinions are separated. Star ratings are not semantic labels.
topic_definition: Multi-label descriptions of the visible prefix only; categories may overlap and are not verification of allegations
